name: PO Pilot — Monday Collections Chaser (net-30 aging + reminder drafts)

parameters.content:
## PO Pilot n8n template #2: Monday collections

**Flow:** Weekly schedule → pull OPEN / INVOICE_SENT draft orders from Shopify → compute net-terms aging → draft a polite reminder email per overdue buyer in Gmail (**drafts only — you press send**).

**Setup (5 min):**
1. HTTP node: replace `YOUR-STORE.myshopify.com` + `YOUR_SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN` (scopes: read_draft_orders).
2. Gmail node: connect your Google account; emails land in Drafts for review.
3. Schedule: default Monday 08:00. Adjust timezone in workflow settings.

Pairs with template #1 — the drafts it creates carry the `wholesale` + `po-*` tags and 'Payment terms: NET 30' note this workflow reads.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: '{ draftOrders(first: 50, sortKey: CREATED_AT, reverse: true) { nodes { id name status invoiceUrl createdAt totalPrice email tags note customer { displayName } } } }' }) }}

nodes.name: Save as Gmail Draft
nodes.notes: n8n Gmail node creates DRAFTS when 'Send' is off — review, then hit send. Items with empty `to` are skipped automatically (filter: to not empty).

meta.description: PO Pilot bundle template #2 — weekly net-30/60 aging over Shopify draft orders; writes polite reminder emails as Gmail drafts for one-click review.
